title: Easy School Lunches for Kids: Delicious Homemade Pizza Rolls Everyone Will Love
promptIMG: Food photography: homemade pizza rolls, appetizing presentation, natural lighting, kitchen setting, documentary style, realistic colors --ar 4:3 --quality 2

image_prompts.img1: SCENE: a cozy home kitchen softly blurred in the background with warm daylight filtering through a window. SUBJECT: a generous pile of golden-brown homemade pizza rolls overflowing on a rustic white ceramic plate, filling nearly the entire frame. The front pizza roll is razor sharp, angled to showcase its crispy, flaky crust with visible melted cheese peeking from the edges. DETAILS: the rolls have a glistening, caramelized surface with slight bubbling cheese and a sprinkle of dried oregano on top. Crumbs and tiny bits of tomato sauce dot the plate naturally. STYLE: ultra-photorealistic professional food photography with bright, airy daylight and rich, warm golden hues that enhance the inviting look of the rolls; shallow depth of field focusing on the front roll. AVOID: no text, hands, or logos; no steam or over-smoothing; natural textures and colors only.
image_prompts.img2: SCENE: soft natural light with a blurred marble countertop in the background. SUBJECT: a close-up reveal shot of a pizza roll torn open to show the molten, gooey mozzarella cheese stretching out, vibrant red tomato sauce layered inside with visible bits of herbs and pepperoni. The torn halves face the camera, filling 90% of the frame, highlighting the soft, pillowy interior contrasted with the crispy crust edges. DETAILS: the cheese glistens wet and glossy, the tomato sauce rich and textured, with a few scattered crumbs below. STYLE: ultra-photorealistic food photography with bright daylight and warm golden tones emphasizing the inviting texture and colors; shallow macro depth of field. AVOID: no hands, no text, no artificial colors or shadows, no steam.
image_prompts.img3: SCENE: warm dark wood surface softly blurred behind with a gentle side glow highlighting the food. SUBJECT: several pizza rolls arranged closely on a rustic wooden board with a small bowl of marinara sauce for dipping placed beside them. The front pizza roll is sharp, topped with a sprinkle of fresh basil and a light dusting of parmesan cheese. DETAILS: intense glossy shine on the crust, deep golden caramelization, and the sauce shows a rich vibrant red with herbs. A few crumbs and herbs are scattered naturally on the board. STYLE: ultra-photorealistic professional food photography with deep golden-amber warmth and rich saturated colors, shallow depth of field focusing on the front roll. AVOID: no hands, no text, no logos, no steam or smoke.
